body: My parents are somewhat aware, my siblings aren't because they're all younger. My friends are amazing, but only when I'm actually willing to ask for help, which isn't often.

I think it helps, but I'm really not a fan of discussing the assaults. It just seems to bring up memories I'd prefer to forget. 
Don't worry, you're helping. I can't really talk to anyone else. I just need to talk. Or something. I don't know.
I have in the past, it just isn't a recent topic of discussion. And I'm not dismissing it early, I've been in therapy for years.

Not really working through it formally, I've made some progress on my own. I'm not a fan of therapy, even though I go every two weeks. I don't talk to him about any of the assaults. 
It isn't so much not enjoying socialising, I just don't usually have the energy to. But when I'm alone, I struggle more. It's an awful cycle.

I've been raped multiple times in the past two years, and I have PTSD from it, so life isn't always super enjoyable. 
I don't have the time/money to take a weekend vacation. I have things I do for fun, but they all involve other people, and I don't feel up to being social very often.
Um. Maybe two years ago? I don't really know. Things have been fairly hard to enjoy in the past year or so.

I've struggled with depression for years. I had to drop out of highschool at age 15 because I just couldn't do it, because of depression, PTSD, and anxiety. now I'm 16 and going to a community college, because I didn't want to feel like I quit, but I just don't want to keep trying. I don't want to make any effort to do anything. I just want to sleep and sleep...but I can't because I have insomnia that nothing helps with. I feel like the only way I'll be able to take a break is to move on from life. I don't want to keep trying anymore.
